correctness.rationale: The actual rational stability function is F(z)=(z²-6z+12)/(z²+6z+12). Since the SRG adjacency algebra is span(I,A,J), its Laplacian has eigenvalues 0,alpha,beta with alpha+beta=s, alpha beta=N mu. Exact spectral projector algebra gives nonedge entry 12alpha beta h²(6+sh)/(N D_alpha D_beta)>0 and edge entry 12h[12+6p h/N+p(s-N)h²/N]/(D_alpha D_beta). The diagonal is positive from F(h alpha), F(h beta)>0. The sign quadratic has a single positive root iff s<N; row/column sums equal one. I independently inverted the 10x10 Petersen rational matrix at h=4: diagonal 1783/4123, nonedge 408/4123, edge -36/4123, row sum 1. At h=0 offdiagonals vanish as required.
